title: Skillet {p} with {v}
steps: Start the sides first, since they take the longest. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Pat the {p} dry and leave out of the fridge for 15 minutes. Rub with the {spice}, salt and pepper.
Sear the {p} in a hot, oiled skillet 3 to 4 minutes per side until browned and {doneness}. Rest 3 minutes.
Pour the {sauce} into the hot pan, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer until glossy. Spoon over the {p} and serve with the {v} and {s}.
tip: Trim the visible fat before cooking and fill half the plate with the vegetable.
